rationale: Both candidates miss the two actual ground-truth concerns (the current_omni_platform.device suggestion and trimming the redundant UT), so recall is low and roughly tied for each. X finds a materially deeper, technically verified bug that Y completely misses: torch.random.fork_rng defaults device_type='cuda' independent of the devices list, so passing a MUSA/other device without device_type still saves/restores via torch.cuda — Y's 'Validated' section even incorrectly certifies the fork_rng usage as fine. Both correctly catch the FL2VA/Ref2VA doc mismatch and the ambiguous test-file citation, but X pairs its findings with concrete, ready-to-apply patches and ties the unpicklable device_module attribute to the doc's own spawn config, giving it a clear edge in precision and actionability.
